facts.business: Career Point Edutech Ltd provides comprehensive management services for K-12 schools, colleges, and universities (formal education) and standardized test preparation through franchisee centres, partner schools, and online platforms.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company has significant headroom to enhance capacity utilisation across existing enterprise clients, creating a clear pathway to higher revenues and improved profitability.

key_risks: Forward-looking statements subject to risks, uncertainties, and inaccurate assumptions; actual results could vary materially.
facts.related_party_note: Composite Scheme of Arrangement between Srajan Capital Limited, CP Capital Limited, and Career Point Edutech Limited resulted in demerger of Education Business and allotment/cancellation of equity shares.
